bundle.shortDescription: An animated desktop companion with a local AI agent.
bundle.longDescription: IronClaw Desktop is an animated character companion that runs a local AI agent (llama.cpp) alongside cloud LLMs, with browser automation, a canvas, and hands-free voice — all from a single offline install.
